name: One model version
description: One row, one `body` column, built by Postgres. `trial` is soma-gaps 2.4: a version sits in `verified` while its trial match is queued or being played, and without this the Submit screen would show a submission that had simply stopped moving. It carries the trial's own status and when it was queued, so the wait can be stated rather than guessed at. `provisional` is now sigma against the settled threshold from [vars] -- the same number pair's demand view calls settled -- rather than a hardcoded matches_played < 20 that could disagree with it. Layer 08 §10: `phase` is the sentence the Version screen shows -- queued, verifying, awaiting_trial, on_the_ladder, rejected, superseded -- because a competitor needs to know which of the two clocks their version is waiting on. NOTHING SWEEPS A `verified` VERSION (decision 40): the old stale-admission lockout is now the trial wait, and the fix is to make it visible rather than to cancel it, which is what `trial.waiting_s` is for. The two hashes come back so a competitor can check that what was admitted is what they built. SOMA-GAPS 2.5: `rank` and `field` come from model_ratings() in the migration, so this route, the profile and the caller's own list cannot drift from the leaderboard. The rank is against the season's current field, which is the only field there is -- a superseded version keeps its ratings rows and gets a rank too, meaning where it would place among the versions playing now. `baseline` says the owner is a platform baseline rather than a competitor, which the page needs before it decides to print an owner link at all, and `last_played_at` is the home panel's `last played 4 min ago`. `class_max_bytes` is the cap this version was measured against, read from ITS OWN season: the caps are per season now, so a headroom bar is drawn against the season the version was entered in, not whatever the live season says today.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'id', m.id, 'owner', u.handle, 'game', g.slug, 'version', m.version, 'repo', m.repo, 'release_tag', m.release_tag, 'commit_sha', m.commit_sha, 'class', m.weight_class, 'class_max_bytes', (SELECT (e ->> 'max_bytes')::bigint FROM seasons cse, jsonb_array_elements(cse.weight_classes) AS e WHERE cse.id = m.season_id AND e ->> 'class' = m.weight_class::text), 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes, 'param_count', m.param_count, 'flops_estimate', m.flops_estimate, 'weights_hash', m.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', m.adapter_hash, 'evaluator_digest', m.evaluator_digest, 'status', m.status, 'phase', CASE WHEN m.status = 'testing' AND m.admit_started_at IS NULL THEN 'queued' WHEN m.status = 'testing' THEN 'verifying' WHEN m.status = 'verified' THEN 'awaiting_trial' WHEN m.status = 'active' THEN 'on_the_ladder' WHEN m.status = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'superseded' END, 'admit_attempt', CASE WHEN m.status = 'testing' THEN m.admit_attempts END, 'successor', (SELECT s.version FROM models s WHERE s.owner_id = m.owner_id AND s.game_id = m.game_id AND s.status = 'active' AND s.season_id = m.season_id AND m.status = 'superseded'), 'reject_reason', m.reject_reason, 'created_at', m.created_at, 'season', (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = m.season_id), 'trial', (SELECT json_build_object('match_id', t.id, 'status', t.status, 'preset', t.preset, 'queued_at', t.created_at, 'waiting_s', CASE WHEN t.status = 'pending' THEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.created_at))::bigint END) FROM matches t WHERE t.trial_model_id = m.id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'ratings', model_ratings(m.id, ($2)::float8), 'baseline', u.role = 'baseline', 'last_played_at', (SELECT max(mt.played_at) FROM match_seats ms JOIN matches mt ON mt.id = ms.match_id WHERE ms.model_id = m.id)) AS body FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id WHERE m.id = ($1)::uuid
